verdict.line: You lose if you eat his Q-E combo point-blank before level 3; you win once E (Flawless Duet) is online and you start dictating engage timing.

brief.thesis: Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anything caught between the two blades, and a Marked target refreshes Q (Bladesurge) on hit — that combo lets her choose the exact moment to fight. Aatrox has no stun; his only answer is landing Q's swings and sticking with the short-cooldown E (Umbral Dash, 9/8/7/6/5s) to keep damaging and healing off you. With lane advantage, solo-kill advantage, and a 53.5% win rate over 734 games, this is a matchup Irelia should be pressing, not surviving.

theirWindow.when: he leads Q into an E dash onto you
theirWindow.what: Aatrox's Q slams down with three possible swing areas, and his passive heals him whenever E (Umbral Dash) damages you on the dash in. Stay outside 850 range (your E's range) until you've seen where his Q lands, and if he closes with E, disengage rather than trade face-to-face — his Deathbringer Stance empowered auto plus the E sustain wins prolonged exchanges.

yourWindow.when: his E (Umbral Dash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With his dash down for 5-9 seconds depending on rank, he can't reposition or stick to a retreat. Walk in with Q (Bladesurge) to close, land E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then recast Q on the Marked target — it dies or refreshes the cooldown and heals you, and you get a free reset before his E comes back up.

start.why: The highest-winning start into Aatrox (53.4% over 772 games) — the extra HP and sustain absorb his Q pokes while you wait for E at level 2/3.

boots.why: 52.7% win rate and by far the most-picked boots here (80.4%) — flat physical damage reduction blunts his Q swings and his auto-attacks, both physical.

core.why: Highest-winning core path into Aatrox (56.2%, 22.1% pick) — current-health damage and the slow help you stick through his E dash.
Continues the top-performing build path and gives raw stats to keep winning extended trades once BORK is up.
Damage mitigation over time lets you survive his all-in windows and outlast the healing from his passive and E.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-winning page for this matchup (54.1%, 32.4% pick) — stacking Conqueror in extended trades rewards Irelia's dash-reset combat pattern against a champion who can't stun her off it.

summoners.why: Run by 94% of Irelia players in this matchup at a 52.8% win rate — Ignite punishes his passive and E healing, and Flash covers your E (850 range) engage or a bad Q (Bladesurge) commitment.

playing.title: Hold E range until his Q lands
playing.detail: His Q slams down with three possible swing areas and he can follow up with E (Umbral Dash) to close distance. Stay just outside 850 range until you've seen the Q resolve, then step in.

playing.title: Trade at max passive stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor grants bonus on-hit damage at maximum stacks. Bait his cooldowns with autos first, then commit Q (Bladesurge) once you're capped for the bonus damage.

playing.title: Charge W into his all-in
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) reduces physical damage taken while charging and hits harder the longer it's held. Start charging as he swings Q so you eat less of it and answer with a bigger hit.

playing.title: Stun when his E is down
playing.detail: E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks anything caught between the two blades. Land it while his E (Umbral Dash, 9-5s cooldown by rank) is on cooldown so he can't dash out of the follow-up.

playing.title: Walk out of his W zone immediately
playing.detail: W (Infernal Chains) only damages once on the initial hit — if you're caught you have to leave the impact area quickly or get dragged to the center and take it again. Move out on sight, don't trade through it.

playing.title: Play around his 120s ultimate
playing.detail: R (World Ender) fears nearby minions and gives him AD, more healing, and move speed for the rest of its duration. Avoid committing to long fights right after level 6 and look to punish the ~80-120s it's down.

playing.title: Force fights once BORK completes
playing.detail: Blade of the Ruined King's current-health damage plus your Q sustain wins skirmishes outright by level 9-13. Start initiating rather than waiting once the item is online.

brief.patchCaveat: Item paths, runes, summoners, and the win-rate/pick-rate figures above come from OP.GG's measured games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the two kits.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance to avoid being hit by Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo. Close in to engage combat with [Q] when Irelia has 4 stacks [P] prepared. Absorb Aatrox’s skill damage with a well-timed [W].
